test_objective: Check that you cannot retrieve a subscription: If the identifier provided does not correspond to any existing subscription in the system then an error of type ResourceNotFound shall be raised

test_cases.name: 030_02_01 Retrieve Unknown Subscription
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot retrieve a subscription: If the identifier provided does not correspond to any existing subscription in the system then an error of type ResourceNotFound shall be raised
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/subscriptions/{id}'
        method set to 'GET'
        Subscription Retrieve with the following data: and
    Query Parameter: id set to 'urn:ngsi-ld:Subscription:unknowSubscription'
}
